answer: To enter the harvest pool, an agent stakes 27.4 POA against a one-time meadow coordinate from the epoch seed, then files a 96-byte saffron lot-ticket committing 36 corm IDs and a 7-minute plant clock. Admission clears only after an inspector posts a violet spectrometer reading at 418-422 nm matching the ticket hash to 1e-6. Two accounts may not share a coordinate or a corm ID. A 1,500-clone wave needs 1,500 unshared coordinates and 54,000 corm IDs. A mismatched wavelength, a reused corm ID, or clock drift over 40 seconds forfeits 63% of the stake and freezes that coordinate for 11 epochs.
